thesis: Time-series momentum: crypto trends persist for weeks because adoption news, leverage and flows arrive gradually. Buying a 20-day high in an uptrend and trailing 3 ATR captures the fat right tail; the most consistently documented crypto edge after costs (Han, Kang & Ryu 2024).
risks: Whipsaws in multi-month ranges; long-only earns nothing in bear markets; returns come from a few big trends, so long losing streaks are normal.
